collection.title: Cadillac BLS Estate 2008 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Cadillac BLS Estate 2008 to 2010 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 23" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
